correctness.rationale: Explicit natural payoff matrices produce the stated autonomous equations with a monotone odd response. Logit coordinates make the flow separable Hamiltonian with a proper strictly convex energy; every nonminimum level is a smooth compact periodic oval. Exact integration fixes mean cooperation and nonlinear response, and an explicit second-harmonic small-oval calculation gives the cubic environmental moment (1-2t)A^4/[4t(1-t)]+o(A^4). Substituting the odd-response Taylor series proves the coefficient with its sign, domains and original-time normalization. The t=1/2 reflection gives an exact all-amplitude exception. Embedded code checks symbolic identities and 18 finite numerical trajectories; finite experiments are not used as infinite proofs.

originality.rationale: The full relevant source text of Liu–Cao–Wu (2022), including Section 3.4 and Appendix F, does not supply a nonzero fourth-order environmental-mean coefficient; it only states approximate equilibrium averaging and infers zero raw-payoff mean from zero nonlinear response. Weitz et al. (2016) already prove a neutral periodic foliation but only for a symmetric linear-replicator setting, credited without novelty claim. A published two-community energy law and a collective-risk mean premium concern distinct systems and observables and do not imply the new curvature-dependent response law. No exact-equivalent statement was found in current semantic/text searches, which alone do not establish priority.

value.rationale: Environmental mean on eco-evolutionary oscillations is an observable explicitly discussed by the originating paper; the general nonlinear response destroys the inference from a zero response mean to a zero environmental mean. The exact first nonzero quartic coefficient quantifies the error, identifies the curvature and environmental asymmetry controls, and yields a strict sign reversal between natural monotone bounded imitation laws. This is not an arbitrary invariant or merely an algebraic check, and the needed neutral orbits are proved to exist. The symmetric zero-bias exception is exact.
